quest.title: Floral Pursuit
quest.description: Plauen of the Adventurers' Guild seems to be busy with something...

talks.objective: Go to Mondstadt's side gate to look for Plauen

dialogues.speaker: Plauen
dialogues.text: *sigh* Can the Guild really manage this amount of work...

dialogues.speaker: Plauen
dialogues.text: Ah, Traveler! My apologies for not noticing you sooner. I had some Guild affairs on my mind...

dialogues.speaker: Plauen
dialogues.text: You must be here in Mondstadt for the Windblume Festival, I presume?

dialogues.speaker: Plauen
dialogues.text: You're just in time: The Guild has just come up with a little game — a guaranteed romp with prizes to be won!

dialogues.speaker: Plauen
dialogues.text: How about it? Wanna give it a go?

dialogues.speaker: Plauen
dialogues.text: Let me introduce this little game to you first. The person who designed it calls it "Floral Chess."

dialogues.speaker: Plauen
dialogues.text: He said that his inspiration came from the billowing petals and the wind that pursues them...

dialogues.speaker: Plauen
dialogues.text: And the game is meant to imitate the... romanticism of pursuing these flower petals...

response.speaker: Plauen
response.text: Well, this inventor is a bard, so he has more of... You know, an imagination.

response.speaker: Plauen
response.text: Basically, when you're playing this form of chess, you need to collect as many Bloom Balloons within the chessboard as possible.

response.speaker: Plauen
response.text: You'll have to avoid various obstacles in the process... and there'll be some tools on hand to lend you some support...

response.speaker: Plauen
response.text: That fellow even wrote an entire manual for this game, which I'll let you have a look at later.

response.speaker: Plauen
response.text: If you're interested, you're welcome to play. Remember, prizes are guaranteed just for participating!
